before.title: Weiman Poetics: Radiance Gel 50ml
before.descriptionHtml:
Weiman Poetics Radiance Serum

Exosome-Powered Skin Renewal

Discover the future of skincare with Weiman Poetics Radiance Serum, infused with cutting-edge exosome technology to awaken your skin’s natural glow from within.

Powered by Exosomes

Formulated with high-purity exosomes, this serum delivers cell-to-cell communication signals that help:

  • Stimulate skin regeneration

  • Repair damaged and sensitive skin

  • Boost collagen production for improved firmness

  • Strengthen the skin barrier at the foundational level

Key Benefits

• Revitalizes Dull Skin – Enhances luminosity and clarity.
• Soothes Sensitivity – Calms and restores fragile complexions.
• Energizes with Vitality – Promotes skin renewal and resilience.
• Lifts & Firms – Improves elasticity and skin density.

Environmental Protection

The serum forms a protective barrier that:

  • Shields skin from heavy metals found in makeup

  • Defends against harmful UV rays, reducing oxidative stress

Experience the science of exosome beauty — for radiant, resilient, and youthfully firm skin.

before.title: Weiman Poetics Dawn Rejuvenation Essence 50ml
before.descriptionHtml:
Reverse Time. Awaken Radiance.

Powered by high-purity exosomes, this cutting-edge essence helps rejuvenate tired skin, firm facial contours, and improve skin texture from the inside out.

✅ Repairs and strengthens sensitive skin barrier
✅ Stimulates collagen and hyaluronic acid regeneration
✅ Helps shield against makeup heavy metals & UV radiation
✅ Visible tightening and brightening after consistent use

Perfect as a primer or daily rejuvenating serum.

For all skin types. Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

before.title: Weiman Poetics : Morning Dew Age-Defying Mist
before.descriptionHtml:
Weiman Poetics Morning Dew Age-Defying Mist

Harnessing high-purity exosome technology, Weiman Poetics Morning Dew Age-Defying Mist delivers a weightless spray that instantly hydrates, reinforces the skin barrier and visibly firms tired complexions. A single press releases nanometer-sized actives that penetrate deep, signaling cells to regenerate collagen and rebalance moisture—so your skin stays luminous, resilient, and fearless of time.

Key Benefits

  • Nanometer Penetration – Micro-droplets carry exosomes into deeper layers.
  • Barrier Recharge – Strengthens four core skin shields for balanced, healthy glow.
  • Hydrate & Soothe – High-moisture mist calms sensitivity and dryness on contact.
  • Travel-Friendly Biotech – No sub-zero storage; science that goes wherever you do.

Fast Facts

Texture Ultra-fine refreshing mist
Format / Size 80 mL spray
Star Actives Exosomes, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, Centella Asiatica
Skin Types All (not recommended during pregnancy / nursing)
Use AM & PM after cleansing or anytime as revitalizing primer

nodes.value: Morning Dew Age-Defying Mist | Exosome Barrier Repair Spray – Weiman Poetics

after.title: Weiman Poetics : Morning Dew Age-Defying Mist
after.descriptionHtml:
Weiman Poetics Morning Dew Age-Defying Mist

Harnessing high-purity exosome technology, Weiman Poetics Morning Dew Age-Defying Mist delivers a weightless spray that instantly hydrates, reinforces the skin barrier and visibly firms tired complexions. A single press releases nanometer-sized actives that penetrate deep, signaling cells to regenerate collagen and rebalance moisture—so your skin stays luminous, resilient, and fearless of time.

Key Benefits

  • Nanometer Penetration – Micro-droplets carry exosomes into deeper layers.
  • Barrier Recharge – Strengthens four core skin shields for balanced, healthy glow.
  • Hydrate & Soothe – High-moisture mist calms sensitivity and dryness on contact.
  • Travel-Friendly Biotech – No sub-zero storage; science that goes wherever you do.

Fast Facts

Texture Ultra-fine refreshing mist
Format / Size 80 mL spray
Star Actives Exosomes, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, Centella Asiatica
Skin Types All (not recommended during pregnancy / nursing)
Use AM & PM after cleansing or anytime as revitalizing primer
